clients: Two unmodified official Minecraft Java 26.2 clients, synthetic players LegendaryRaider and LegendaryRival
method: Private test helper invokes the production ability entry points with live Paper entities; also tested real client Shift+left-air, right-click/recast and Shift+G inputs. Helper is not included in the distribution.

checks.chain: Four unique targets, base HP 6 / 4.5 / 3.375 / 2.53125; first target unarmored, subsequent zombies retain native armor reduction.
checks.mark: Three direct attacks trigger exactly one additional 5 HP discharge.
checks.storm: Four 4 HP pulses separated by exactly 40 ticks, with visual lightning.
checks.zeusArmor: 12 HP base reduced to 1.7227636575698853 by native chest armor / Protection IV / Resistance IV in the test fixture.
checks.friendlyFire: Shared scoreboard team with friendlyFire false: Zeus caused zero damage to ally.
checks.skybreaker: Real right-click starts flight; second right-click descends; outer wave delivered 4 HP once.
checks.heavensFall: Central wave 12 HP once; real Shift+G reached approximately 12 blocks and hovered with gravity false; death restored gravity true and removed pending cast.
checks.windDash: Observed wall cleanup regression fixed with a single landing transition; native cast count zero after wall/landing, then unrelated 2 HP fall damage delivered normally. Real Shift+left-air traveled approximately 9 blocks.
checks.prison: Slowness II present during field, absent after expiry; no damage.
checks.tornado: Two 2 HP pulses before collision with wall stopped the tornado. Per-target 6 HP cap separately unit tested.
checks.axe: One base/final 4 HP health shock despite armor and Resistance IV; configured 8 absorption remained 8. Natural health regeneration can change later health readings.
checks.shadow: One 4 HP base impact at level 5, Slowness and Blindness; leap stopped before solid wall.
checks.blood: Hook 4 HP base and pull; held Strength I at level 4+. Active Trail direct melee healed exactly 12 -> 13 HP. Death removed sessions.
checks.animationCombat: Shadow floating frame 121 active while fully charged native melee dealt normal 8 HP; sentinel damage/name/lore/PDC metadata unchanged apart from visual frame.
checks.progress: Native kill increment, maximum level 5, no further increment at cap, level retained after death. Persistence round trip covered by automated tests.
checks.swapDuringHit: HIGH-priority test listener switched Shadow Blade -> Bloodlust during the same damage event: Shadow 0 -> 1, Bloodlust remained 0.
checks.delayedSwap: Storm cast with Thunder Spear, switched to Bloodlust before lethal pulse: Thunder Spear 0 -> 1, Bloodlust remained 0; vanilla death text named held Bloodlust but progression correctly used original spear.

limits: No production WorldGuard version was installed in the fixture; its optional integration remains a separate server-specific check.
This validates functional defaults, not final PvP balance. The user will playtest and tune the exposed values.
Some native controls were exercised directly; the full gesture routing matrix is additionally covered by unit tests.
